noData: No explicit sentinel or per-pixel observation-density mask in this source label; preserve all signed samples, including zero. Source is gridded/resampled and may include interpolation.
limits: Coarse global relief, approximately7.58km per equatorial pixel; not high-resolution terrain or landing-site navigation.
Source label warns about possible45-degree latitude-band edge artifacts and describes interpolation of incomplete coverage at higher resolutions.
Terrain sampler interpolates the supplied grid; it does not recover subpixel terrain, roughness, boulders or shadow detail.
Exact image alignment, surface normals, tile seams, native Cesium loading/lifecycle and visual result still need runtime qualification before enabling existing Moon terrain.
The existing source-qualified Moon renderer and LROC morphology pack are unchanged.

svsCrossCheck.relation: SVS uint = original PDS signed +20000; each row shifted by720 columns to center0-degree longitude. Use original PDS bytes at runtime to avoid this extra transform.

runtimeStatus: source and sampler prepared; existing Moon terrain not enabled

delivery.strategy: Optional on-demand2MiB source grid. No automatic remote fetch, huge tile pack, renderer dependency, protected pack or Docker volume change.
